research.notes: No page found that directly links this company to OUSD or Brookfield Elementary; identity rests on name, Roseville location and education domain. A separate, unrelated 'Luminous Minds Educational Consulting' (SF Bay Area, college counseling) exists and was ruled out by location. The CA filing is from a third-party aggregator (bizprofile.net), not the Secretary of State site; principal address on it is Loomis, CA. Reviewer should confirm via bizfileonline.sos.ca.gov. Phone (916) 250-8697 appeared only in a search snippet, not on a fetched page, so it is omitted.
